c9b9fdd514a4092b.description: We are looking for an AI Developer with 2–4 years of software/AI development experience to build and evolve customer-facing AI capabilities. You should be comfortable working across LLMs, Python, APIs, RAG, memory, structured outputs, evaluation, observability, and production debugging. **Key Responsibilities** - Develop conversational and Generative AI applications using modern LLMs. - Build and maintain AI backend services using Python and FastAPI or similar frameworks. - Implement prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, streaming, and tool/function calling. - Build RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector search, metadata filtering, reranking, and contextual retrieval. - Implement model routing, retry, timeout, fallback, and error-handling strategies. - Build safeguards for prompt injection, inappropriate tool usage, PII handling, and unreliable model responses. - Develop automated evaluations and regression tests for AI behaviour. - Strong Python programming skills - Experience with FastAPI or similar backend frameworks - Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs - Good understanding of prompt and context engineering - Experience with structured LLM outputs and/or function calling - Understanding of RAG architecture - Understanding of embeddings and vector search - Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party services - Understanding of asynchronous programming - Experience with Git and standard software development practices - Ability to write maintainable and testable production code - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills **** Expected AI Knowledge**** Candidates should have a practical understanding of: - LLMs and transformer fundamentals - Tokens and context windows - Embeddings and semantic similarity - RAG - Prompt and context engineering - Tool/function calling - Structured generation - Hallucination and grounding - Prompt injection - Model latency, quality, and cost trade-offs - Evaluation of non-deterministic AI systems **Good to Have** Experience with some of the following would be valuable: - OpenRouter - OpenAI / Anthropic / Google Gemini APIs - Mem0 - LangGraph - LangChain - Langfuse or LangSmith - Redis - MongoDB / PostgreSQL - Vector databases - Docker - Kubernetes - AWS / Azure / GCP - Background workers and queues - WebSockets and streaming responses Experience building production customer-facing conversational AI applications is particularly valuable. **AI Safety & Reliability** The developer will contribute to building AI systems with appropriate safeguards, including: - Input and output validation - Prompt-injection protection - Tool permission boundaries - PII-aware data handling - Domain-specific guardrails - Safe fallback mechanisms - Human escalation where appropriate - Monitoring and auditability **What We Are Looking For** We are looking for an AI application engineer rather than primarily an ML researcher. The role is focused on combining foundation models with software, APIs, application data, retrieval, memory, workflows, tools, evaluation, and guardrails to create reliable production AI capabilities. A strong candidate should be able to take a requirement such as: "The AI should understand the customer's request, identify the appropriate context, retrieve relevant information, call application services when required, and generate an accurate and safe response." …and convert it into a well-designed, testable, production-ready implementation. We value engineers who enjoy building, experimenting, measuring, debugging, and continuously improving real-world AI systems.

Build the future of banking.

Zeta is a next-generation banking technology company providing cloud-native, fully stackable processing and core banking platforms for issuers. With a focus on scalability, compliance, and innovation, Zeta empowers financial institutions to modernize their technology infrastructure and deliver secure, seamless digital banking experiences.

Our impact runs at real-world scale. Today, over 25 million cards are live on Zeta-powered platforms across 7 countries, supported by a passionate team of 1,700+ Zetanauts across India, the US, EMEA, and Asia. Job Title:- AI/ML Engineer

Experience:- 2 to 3 years

Job Overview:- 

As an AI/ML Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and implementing artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that solve complex business problems. You will work with stakeholders to understand business requirements, gather and preprocess data, build and train deep learning based models, and deploy and integrate them into software applications. Your primary goal will be to develop AI/ML solutions that meet business needs while ensuring that they are accurate, reliable, and scalable.

Responsibilities:-

• Analyze business requirements and develop AI/ML solutions to solve complex problems
• Collect, preprocess, and clean data from various sources to build models
• Build, train, test, and deploy deep learning based models using state-of-the-art techniques and frameworks
• Collaborate with software engineers to integrate AI/ML models into software applications
• Develop and maintain AI/ML infrastructure, including data storage and computing resources
• Monitor and optimize AI/ML models for accuracy, reliability, and scalability
• Create business solutions using LLMs, RAG, and Agentic architecture
• Document and communicate best practices for building and deploying AI/ML models

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, or related field

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills
• If you have a passion for AI/ML and a strong background of deep learning in computer vision and natural language processing, this is an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and contribute to the development of innovative AI/ML solutions.

Why Logicwind

c9cee3af455bef26.description: Company Description Battery Dost is an emerging leader in battery swapping solutions for electric three-wheelers in India, helping reshape the countrys EV ecosystem. The company operates a convenient and efficient battery swapping network that supports multiple battery types and models, reducing vehicle downtime for users. By extending driving range and simplifying access to charging alternatives, Battery Dost enables greater reliability for e-rickshaws, cargo vehicles, and other three-wheeled EVs. Its solutions promote widespread EV adoption, reduce carbon emissions, and contribute to more sustainable urban transportation. Joining Battery Dost offers the opportunity to work on impactful, future-focused technologies in the clean mobility space. Role Description The Finance Analyst Banks, NBFCs, and Leasing at Battery Dost is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. This role is responsible for analyzing and managing financial relationships with banks, non-banking financial companies (NBFCs), and leasing partners to support Battery Dosts expansion and operations. Daily tasks include conducting financial analysis, preparing reports and dashboards, monitoring credit facilities, assessing funding requirements, and supporting negotiations on loan, leasing, and financing terms. The Finance Analyst will collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate investment proposals, manage cash flows related to financing arrangements, and ensure compliance with relevant financial regulations and policies. The role also involves tracking industry trends in EV financing, recommending improvements to financial structures, and contributing to the companys long-term financial planning. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong financial analysis and modeling skills, including proficiency in interpreting financial statements and evaluating credit and lending structures. Candidates should possess capabilities in banking and NBFC relationship management, including experience with loan documentation, leasing arrangements, and negotiations with financial institutions. Candidates should possess knowledge of corporate finance and treasury operations, including cash flow management, funding strategy, and risk assessment. Candidates should possess analytical and research skills, with the ability to gather market data, track industry trends, and present clear, data-driven insights. Candidates should possess strong communication and documentation skills, including report writing, presentation development, and clear stakeholder communication. Relevant qualifications such as a bachelors degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CFA, CA, MBA in Finance) are an advantage. Experience in financial services, EV/automotive, infrastructure, or leasing sectors, particularly in dealing with banks and NBFCs, is highly beneficial. Ability to work on-site in Gurugram, collaborate cross-functionally, use financial software and spreadsheets effectively, and maintain high ethical standards and attention to detail. .
